crew.overview: A cold and mysterious new security guard for a Los Angeles cash truck company surprises his co-workers when he unleashes precision skills during a heist. The crew is left wondering who he is and where he came from. Soon, the marksman's ultimate motive becomes clear as he takes dramatic and irrevocable steps to settle a score.
crew.title: Wrath of Man

crew.overview: A hardened gun-for-hire's latest mission becomes a soul-searching race to survive when he's sent into Bangladesh to rescue a drug lord's kidnapped son.
crew.title: Extraction

crew.overview: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.
crew.title: Barbie

crew.overview: American car designer Carroll Shelby and the British-born driver Ken Miles work together to battle corporate interference, the laws of physics, and their own personal demons to build a revolutionary race car for Ford Motor Company and take on the dominating race cars of Enzo Ferrari at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in France in 1966.
crew.title: Ford v Ferrari

details.biography: Cody in an ex-Professional Motocross and Supercross Racer that saw him travel the world competing in the Worlds toughest events. He got introduced to the film industry in 2012 as a motorcycle specialist on Mad Max Fury Road. Since then Cody has continued to grow as a well rounded stuntman. Cody currently resides in California.
details.name: Cody Mackie
